$comment: Deck slides at 1920 by 1080, each built from a share-image template (brand/assets/image.json) drawn at the slide's size, so a deck shares the posts' layers: the reef, the outline band, hatching, the wordmark tile, the console window, the octopi and the lockup. Bullets is the one layout of its own: the title, points led by the filled check circle (Phosphor CheckCircle, the library's checks) and the lockup, between hatched strips. The words in slots are sample copy, drawn with --sample only. Agenda and timeline are the bullets layout with numbers or a rule; questions is the statement layout on lavender. Neither exists in the brand's files as such: they are built from its layouts and tokens.
